description: Check whether up to 50 phone numbers are registered on WhatsApp before you send to them. Numbers must be E.164 with the leading +; a local number without the country code comes back registered: null. Limited to 10 calls a minute per key.

gateway_id.description: Optional sender. Leave it out and SendKuy picks a live sender on the channel and moves to the next one if it fails.

name: sendkuy_check_whatsapp_numbers
title: Check WhatsApp numbers
